hypothesis: Among canonical equal-weight Q80 subset functions, higher primitive feature-weight mass has a positive association with next-target Top-5 number coverage.
estimand: For each target, compute mean Top-5 hit share over a deterministic uniform sample of canonical formulas at each primitive weight mass k=1..10; estimate the target-level OLS slope of mean hit share on k and test whether its chronological mean is positive.

canonical_grammar.formula_type: equal-weight subset mean represented as primitive integer weighted mean after exact alias collapse
canonical_grammar.complexity: sum of primitive integer weights; invariant to raw aliases and removes cross-raw-size duplicate functions
canonical_grammar.mass_options: Alias feature weights a,b in {0,1,2}; choose s=k-a-b of the other 23 features with unit weight; retain only primitive signatures with gcd 1.

sample.masses_2_to_10: uniform sample without replacement from canonical signatures within each primitive mass

walkforward.state_update: score all sampled formulas for target t before appending target t to occurrence and pair state
walkforward.feature_standardization: cross-sectional z-score over 40 candidate numbers using only current-target prior-only feature values

primary_endpoint: mean Top-5 hit share per formula and target

baselines.equal_complexity_ensemble: unweighted mean of ten complexity-stratum shares
baselines.discovery_selected_complexity: complexity mass with highest Discovery mean Top-5 share; tie broken toward smaller mass; frozen before Validation and Blind OOS

tests: positive Top-5 complexity slope in each of 3 splits (3)
Top-5 excess over uniform for each of 10 masses in Validation and Blind OOS (20)
Discovery-selected complexity versus equal-complexity ensemble in Validation and Blind OOS (2)
inference.paired_time_series_method: one-sided block sign-flip using contiguous chronological blocks of 20 targets
inference.confidence_intervals: circular moving-block bootstrap, 20,000 replicates, block length 20

exclusions: No Q89 extension features, Q90 interactions/gates, Q7 candidate-quintet formulas, or Q92 non-equal-weight output types.
No formula or complexity stratum is selected using Validation or Blind OOS.
No post-target formula discovery or target-derived feature is permitted.
Historical Blind OOS is exposed research history, not virgin prospective evidence.
decision_rule: A positive blind complexity trend is exploratory only; no engine promotion is permitted. Report nulls and all registered tests.
